def transform(grid):
    # The separators partition the grid into 4x4 cells, each containing a 2x2 pattern.
    # Mark the cells containing two marked-color pixels.
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    separator = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [len(grid)]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [len(grid[0])]
    from collections import Counter
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != separator)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(row_edges, row_edges[1:]):
        if b - a <= 1: continue
        line=[]
        for c, d in zip(col_edges, col_edges[1:]):
            if d - c <= 1: continue
            count=sum(grid[r][x] != background and grid[r][x] != separator for r in range(a+1,b) for x in range(c+1,d))
            line.append(1 if count == 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
